title: List Reservation Sub-blocks Health
description: Read-only JSON listing of every sub-block in one GCE reservation block (for TPU7x one sub-block = one 4x4x4 cube = one GKE TPU node pool of 16 VMs). Read per sub-block: `name`, `physicalTopology.subBlock` (joins to the node label `cloud.google.com/gce-topology-subblock`), `healthInfo{healthStatus, degradedHostCount, degradedInfraCount, healthyHostCount}`, `inUseCount` and `reservationSubBlockMaintenance{maintenanceOngoingCount, instanceMaintenanceOngoingCount, upcomingGroupMaintenance.maintenanceStatus}`. Caveats: `healthyHostCount` reflects capacity assurance, not live VM placement, so a sub-block can report 16/16 healthy while one host cannot start a VM; `degradedInfraCount` > 0 while all 16 machines are serving points to an ICI/OCS infrastructure fault rather than a bad host. Cheap (~2.5 s in the source). Drill into a single sub-block with [[describe-reservation-sub-blocks]].
instruction: gcloud beta compute reservations sub-blocks list ${reservation_name} --block-name=${block_name} --zone=${zone} --project=${project_id} --format=json

block_name.description: FULL reservation block name, e.g. <reservation>-block-0001 (not just the block index).

project_id.description: GCP project that owns the reservation.
